title: Skypiea Golden Bell
description: An audio resource pack that changes the vanilla bell to the legendary Golden Bell from One Piece's Skypiea arc.
body:
Bring the epic and emotional climax of the **Skypiea arc** right into your **Minecraft** world! This resource pack replaces the standard, clunky Minecraft bell sound with the beautiful, resonant chime of **the Golden Bell of Shandora from One Piece**.

Whether you are building a massive golden city in the clouds, defending a village from a raid, or just want a much better-sounding bell to wake up your villagers, this pack delivers that iconic, majestic ring.

### **Features**

- **Epic Audio Replacement:** Swaps the default vanilla bell sound with the high-quality, lingering chime of the Skypiea bell.

- **Immersive Atmosphere:** Perfect for anime-themed worlds, skyblock survival, or massive custom builds.
  
- **Lightweight:** It only touches the audio files, meaning it won't lag your game or clash with your favorite texture packs. Just layer it on top!

### **Requirements**
- **Minecraft Version:** 1.17 and above.

- **OptiFine:** required for optimal performance and audio engine compatibility.

### **How to Install**
1. Download the .zip file.

2. Open Minecraft and go to Options > Resource Packs.

3. Click Open Pack Folder.

4. Drag and drop the downloaded .zip file into the folder.

5. Move the pack to the "Selected" side in-game and make sure it is layered above any other packs that might change game sounds.

6. Ring the bell and let it be heard all the way to the blue sea!
